title: Courgette Fudge Brownies
changes_from_base: Grated-courgette batter made in a food processor, finished with a chocolate fudge icing.
summary: Moist cocoa brownies made with puréed courgette and topped with a chocolate fudge icing.
equipment: 23 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Line the 23 cm square tin with baking paper and heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Blitz the courgette with the melted butter, eggs and vanilla in a food processor until completely smooth.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Add the sugar, cocoa, espresso powder, baking powder, salt and flour and pulse just until combined, then add the first lot of chocolate chips and pulse a few times.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into the tin and bake 25-30 min, until a cocktail stick comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Icing
steps.text: Heat the cream until steaming, pour it over the remaining chips, leave 5 min and stir until glossy. Spread over the warm brownies.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Cool completely so the icing sets, then cut into 16.

tips: Purée the courgette until no green flecks remain.
No need to peel or salt the courgette.
Spread the icing while the brownies are warm.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep airtight in a cool place for up to 3 days, or in the fridge for up to 5 days.
